ios.desc:
Get everyone together with our online invitation maker and event management app. Choose between classic stationery-inspired Cards or textable event page Flyer invites, customize everything in minutes, send your way (email, text, or Shareable Link), and track RSVPs all in our event management app. No ads, ever!

**Featured as Apple App of the Day and in Vogue, The New York Times, and Fast Company**

- Browse thousands of best-in-class online invitations and greeting cards, or upload your own

- Use our invitation maker to customize a template with fonts, colors, images, GIFs, stickers, envelopes and liners, stamps, and backdrops

- Design free, textable event pages from scratch using photos, GIFs, stickers, filters, and more

- Add event details without cluttering your invitation using informational Blocks

- Collect helpful information with Guest Questions and Surveys

- Connect your contacts list to add recipients in seconds

- Add a co-host to help manage RSVPs, broadcast party updates, and privately message guests

- Send via messaging apps and social media with shareable invitation links

- Manage your guest list with Guest Tags and send updates directly

- Seamlessly check guests into your event on-site

- Stay on top of events you've been invited to, message hosts instantly, and manage your RSVPs on the go


CUSTOM ONLINE INVITATION TEMPLATES FOR ANY OCCASION
